request.style: English, male solo voice with gospel choir, piano, drums, trumpet, strings, somber and urgent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
King Zedekiah made a covenant with all the people
To proclaim liberty for every Hebrew slave
The officials and the crowd who entered the pact
Obeyed the word and set their brothers free

[Chorus]
But you turned back and profaned my name
Took back the men and women you had released
I made a covenant with your fathers long ago
But you did not listen to the voice of the Lord

[Verse]
You cut the calf in two and walked between the pieces
Profaning the name in the house that bears my glory
I will make you like the calf they cut in half
Your corpses food for birds and beasts of the earth

[Chorus]
But you turned back and profaned my name
Took back the men and women you had released
I made a covenant with your fathers long ago
But you did not listen to the voice of the Lord

[Bridge]
So now I proclaim liberty for you declares the Lord
Liberty to the sword and to the plague and famine
I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth
Handing you over to those who seek your lives

[Verse]
Zedekiah and his officials will face their enemies
The army of Babylon that has withdrawn from you
They will fight against this city and capture it
And burn it down to make a desolation

[Chorus]
But you turned back and profaned my name
Took back the men and women you had released
I made a covenant with your fathers long ago
But you did not listen to the voice of the Lord

[Outro]
The cities of Judah will be empty
With no one living in the ruins left behind
